description: Creates an image given a prompt.

async.description: Async task if the model supports it.

cfg_scale.description: Model-specific image CFG scale. See get_model.

frame_duration_ms.description: Milliseconds per GIF frame; output_format gif only.

height.description: Model-specific output height in pixels. See get_model.

image.description: Local reference image upload for compatible image-to-image models. Pass local file path.

prompt.description: Image prompt; required only if get_model lists prompt.

prompt_extend.description: z-image-turbo prompt expansion; default false; true uses expansion pricing.

quality.description: Model-specific image quality; check get_model for accepted values.

reference_image_urls.description: Comma-separated reference image URLs for compatible model families.

size.description: Model-specific image size; check get_model for sizes and limits.

steps.description: Model-specific inference step count. See get_model.

svg.description: SVG settings; output_format svg only; svg.model is required.

width.description: Model-specific output width in pixels. See get_model.
